Asturian

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

secador m (plural secadores)

  1. hairdryer (electrical appliance for drying hair)

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From secar +‎ -dor.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /se.kaˈdoʁ/ [se.kaˈdoh]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /se.kaˈdoʁ/ [se.kaˈdoh]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /se.kaˈdoɾ/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /se.kaˈdoʁ/ [se.kaˈdoχ]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /se.kaˈdoɻ/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /sɨ.kɐˈdoɾ/ [sɨ.kɐˈðoɾ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /sɨ.kɐˈdoɾ/ [sɨ.kɐˈðoɾ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /sɨ.kɐˈdo.ɾi/ [sɨ.kɐˈðo.ɾi]

  • Hyphenation: se‧ca‧dor

Noun

[edit]

secador m (plural secadores)

  1. dryer (any device that removes humidity)
  2. clipping of secador de cabelo

Related terms

[edit]
  • secar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “secador”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “secador”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
secador
Wikipedia es

Etymology

[edit]

From secar +‎ -dor.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /sekaˈdoɾ/ [se.kaˈð̞oɾ]
  • Rhymes: -oɾ
  • Syllabification: se‧ca‧dor

Adjective

[edit]

secador (feminine secadora, masculine plural secadores, feminine plural secadoras)

  1. drying
  2. dryer

Noun

[edit]

secador m (plural secadores)

  1. hair dryer, blow dryer (An electric device for drying hair by blowing hot air on it)
    Synonym: secador de pelo
  2. dryer (any other device, household or industrial, designed to remove water or humidity)
    Synonym: secadora

Derived terms

[edit]
  • secador de piso

Further reading

[edit]
  • “secador”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
